'''Felucian slugs''' were gastropods with a several hard spines on their back. They could grow up to two meters in length. They lived mostly in the Fungal caves. They had spines as opposed to a full shell and tended to inhabit darker areas as compared to the [[Felucian snail/Legends|Felucian snails]] they were related to.<ref name="The Force Unleashed" />
